_doc: Every upstream the local AI stack pins, and the patches we carry on each. upstream-step.py reads this; test_upstreams.py keeps install.sh and serve-patch.sh in step with it. We never send patches to third-party repos: our changes live here and are re-applied on each step. kind: ours = we wrote it; port = someone else's fix carried until our pin reaches it; vendored = third-party code we carry.

omarchy-mlx.step_rule: Step only when upstream moves its install.sh MLX_LM_VERSION default or cuts a release; never run ahead of it.

mlx-lm.step_rule: Follows the MLX_LM_VERSION that our omarchy-mlx pin installs; serve-patch.sh applies these to a copy of the installed mlx_lm.

patches.drop_when: omarchy-mlx's default moves to the mlx-lm 0.32 line

patches.origin: routes 2-6 row passes to omarchy QmmVecQ4WordSubgroupBatch4BF16 (MLX_OMARCHY_QMV_BATCH)
patches.drop_when: omarchy's quantized matmul for 2-8 rows costs no more than the batched one-row kernel
our mlx-lm pin reaches v0.32.0, where TokenizerWrapper.detokenizer copies one prebuilt detokenizer

mlx-lm-032.step_rule: Test candidate only: the 0.32-line mlx-lm in the oMLX venv (install-omlx.sh). serve-patch.sh build-032 makes the patched copy for engine-compare's lm032-patched-120k arm; not the live server.

mesa-mlx-compute.step_rule: Branch-based driver work with no patches of ours; step by hand after the MLX gate and ENGINE-SCOREBOARD.md comparison.

omlx.step_rule: Set by our omarchy-mlx pin's packaging/omlx-linux/install.sh; install-omlx.sh installs it as a test engine (engine-compare omlx-120k), never a default.

tensorfold.step_rule: Pin a PR head by hand after reading its new commits; tensorfold-vulkan.sh refuses a moved head. Built and run by the owner (fetched code).
